response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color, AVG(ili.product_quantity) AS average_invoiced_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY CASE WHEN average_invoiced_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, average_invoiced_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_invoiced_quantity, average_cost_ratio, quantity_rank FROM ranked WHERE quantity_rank <= 3

assumptions.assumption: Non-NULL product_quantity values contain numeric text that the database can average.
